role: Lattice v3 — the CLEAN coupling test. Neither the census representatives (v1, too coarse) nor a stratum-spanning selection (v2, FPT-biased) can measure the approx<->param coupling. v3 uses the EXHAUSTIVE, UNSELECTED, natural population: every non-trivial Boolean relation of arity <= 3, deduped up to coordinate permutation (charges are permutation-invariant), paired with {Min-Ones, Max-Ones}. No selection, no stratification. Its Cramer's V is the honest coupling over the reachable proxy universe.

SEALED_PREDICTION_the_bet_not_just_the_p.primary: coupling PRESENT and POSITIVE — parameterized-hardness (W[1]) co-occurs with approximation-hardness, the SAME DIRECTION as the canon's approx<->param gradient — but WEAKER than the canon's 0.73. Expected Cramer's V roughly 0.15-0.35.
SEALED_PREDICTION_the_bet_not_just_the_p.confidence: ~55% present-positive vs ~45% absent (V's CI includes 0). Genuinely uncertain; sealed so it can be scored either way.
SEALED_PREDICTION_the_bet_not_just_the_p.disclosed_contamination_what_was_NOT_bli: v2's 7 FPT : 1 W[1] marginal was SEEN before sealing this. That is mild contamination and it is stated plainly here for the record. Mitigation on the merits: v2's skew was a canonical-first SELECTION artifact (simplest relation per stratum is weakly separable); the natural population is expected LESS skewed (complex relations fail weak separability -> more W[1]). The parameterized COLUMN on the full 276 has NOT been computed at seal time.
SEALED_PREDICTION_the_bet_not_just_the_p.if_absent: V CI includes ~0 -> NO coupling over the natural generated Boolean universe -> the gradient does not reach even the best population generation can honestly produce -> STRENGTHENS the generation-cannot-reach finding with a clean natural-population measurement (not a selection artifact). This is the higher-information outcome.

procedure.enumerate: all non-empty, non-full Boolean relations of arity 1..3.
procedure.symmetry_dedup: dedup by COORDINATE-PERMUTATION canonical form (minimum over S_arity of the permuted relation). Charges are invariant under variable renaming, so coordinate-permuted relations are the SAME language; keeping all copies would inflate n with non-independent duplicates. NB complementation (0<->1) is NOT a symmetry here — it changes the charges (0-valid<->1-valid, Min<->Max) and is the objective flip, not a dedup.
procedure.roster: each symmetry-class representative x {min-ones, max-ones}. NO selection, NO stratification.
procedure.charges: approximation via KSTW Max-Ones/Min-Ones (objective-dependent); parameterized via Marx Def 2.1 general weak separability (objective-independent); feasibility-hard rows carry parameterized=open (occupancy only).

EFFECTIVE_N_ACCOUNTING_mandatory.report_all_three: raw relation count (all arity<=3), SYMMETRY-CLASS count (distinct up to coordinate permutation), and DISTINCT-PROFILE count (distinct (approx,param) cells). Report row count = symmetry-classes x 2 objectives.
EFFECTIVE_N_ACCOUNTING_mandatory.V_error_bars_sized_to_the_smaller_number: the headline Cramer's V is computed on the symmetry-deduped both-real rows; its uncertainty is a BOOTSTRAP CI resampling the SYMMETRY-CLASS rows (NOT the raw 276) — so the CI reflects the true number of independent observations. The DISTINCT-PROFILE count is reported as the coarsest resolution limit. A headline V on ~550 rows that is really ~N classes would repeat exactly the v1 mistake; the CI must be sized to N, not 550.
EFFECTIVE_N_ACCOUNTING_mandatory.floor: if the symmetry-class or distinct-profile count is small enough that the V's CI spans [<=0, >0.4] (uninformative), report RESOLUTION-LIMITED rather than a point verdict.

analysis.primary: the (approximation x parameterized) OCCUPANCY cross-tab over the natural population (symmetry-deduped both-real rows) + the per-cell counts.
analysis.secondary_association: Cramer's V (structure.cramers_v) + bootstrap CI sized to the symmetry-class count; per-objective (min vs max) as well as pooled; direction read from the ordinalized ranks (approx easy->hard, param FPT<W[1]).
analysis.no_sampling_null: deterministic given the enumeration; occupancy is the object; any envelope is comparability-only.

scope_line_for_the_writeup: v3's V is the natural coupling over the REACHABLE PROXY UNIVERSE (single-relation Boolean, two objectives) — NOT 'the gradient outside the canon' full stop. The generation-cannot-reach finding still stands (global-objective problems remain unreachable); this is the BEST population generation can honestly reach, which is exactly why it is worth measuring. Comparability to the canon's 0.73 is fair on the CURATED-vs-GENERATED axis, but BOTH numbers stay population-scoped: 0.73 = curated-not-stratified canon; v3's V = generated-not-stratified Boolean proxy.
